Description: Cell coordinates transformed from raw image space into Unified mouse brain atlas (Kim lab) (20x20x50 µm resolution) using the ClearMap2 elastix-based registration pipeline.  Registration was computed by aligning autofluo_for_signal_resampled to autofluo_resampled, then applying the resulting deformation field to the raw cell coordinates (items 6 & 7 in the data description).

z.Description: Z coordinate in Unified mouse brain atlas (Kim lab) (A-P axis)

y.Description: Y coordinate in Unified mouse brain atlas (Kim lab) (D-V axis)

x.Description: X coordinate in Unified mouse brain atlas (Kim lab) (M-L axis)
